summary.text: Jamila Taylor is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 30-Position 1 since January 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Tiffany Bowyer.

paragraphs.text: Jamila Taylor lives in Federal Way, Washington.
Taylor earned a bachelor's degree from Virginia State University and a law degree from the University of Oregon.

Her career experience includes working as an attorney, as the central area network coordinator with the Seattle Youth Violence Prevention Initiative, and founding a legal practice and nonprofit consulting business.

Taylor assumed office in the Washington House on January 11, 2021, and her 2023-2024 committee assignments included the Housing, Human Services, Youth, & Early Learning, and House Transportation committees.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 63.3 percent of the vote.
